summary.text: Eligibility is automatic. Eligible cash top-ups to your MediSave Account by 31 December earn a matching grant early the next year.

details.heading: Eligibility and notice
details.body: Your eligibility is checked automatically each year. You do not need to apply. If you are eligible, CPF will notify you at the beginning of the year.

details.heading: Make a cash top-up
details.body: Cash top-ups to your MediSave Account can be made by you, loved ones, employers or community members.

details.heading: Receive the matching grant
details.body: If you are eligible and receive a cash top-up by 31 December, you will receive a matching grant at the beginning of the following year.

details.heading: When it starts
details.body: The scheme starts in January 2026. Cash top-ups made before 2026 are not eligible for matching grants under this scheme.

quotes.text: Members’ eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme (MMSS) will be automatically assessed annually.
Members’ eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme (MMSS) will be automatically assessed annually. No application by members is needed.
Cash top-ups to MA can be made by yourself, loved ones, employers or members of the community.
If you are eligible and have received cash top-ups to your MediSave Account (MA) by 31 December of the year, you will receive a matching grant at the beginning of the following year.
MMSS is implemented from January 2026. Cash top-ups made before 2026 is not eligible for matching grants under this scheme.
